_como_usar: O campo 'style' do Suno é montado nesta ordem: estilo (o gênero vem primeiro e manda) + clima (só o sentimento, nunca um gênero: 'ballad' puxava tudo para balada) + voz. 'negativo' (geral) + 'negativo_estilo' do estilo vão em 'Etiquetas negativas'. Para mudar o som, mude aqui e gere as amostras de novo (musica.ferramentas.gerar_amostras).

estilos.sertanejo: modern Brazilian sertanejo, sofrência, acoustic guitar and accordion, punchy modern drums and bass, emotional sing-along chorus, heartfelt vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.gospel: Brazilian contemporary worship music (louvor e adoração), atmospheric synth pads, ambient electric guitar swells with reverb, piano-led, big drum build-up to an anthemic chorus, worship leader vocals with congregation singing along, church choir, spiritual and uplifting, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.pagode: Brazilian pagode romântico, cavaquinho, pandeiro, banjo, tantã, rebolo, swinging samba groove, smooth romantic vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.samba: samba, cavaquinho, pandeiro, surdo, tamborim, cuíca, festive roda de samba groove, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.forro: Brazilian forró, sanfona (accordion) lead, zabumba and triangle, danceable northeastern groove, warm festive vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.mpb: MPB (música popular brasileira), nylon-string acoustic guitar, soft percussion, sophisticated Brazilian harmony, warm intimate vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.pop: Brazilian pop, catchy melody, modern polished production, bright synths and drums, radio-friendly chorus, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.romantica: Brazilian romantic ballad, piano and strings, slow tempo, lush arrangement, tender heartfelt vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.bossa: bossa nova, nylon guitar with bossa rhythm, soft brushed drums, upright bass, gentle relaxed vocals, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.rock: Brazilian rock, distorted electric guitars, driving drums, strong bass, energetic raw attitude, powerful slightly raspy vocals with sustained notes and dynamic shifts, guitar solo, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.axe: axé music, Bahia carnival, heavy percussion (timbau, surdo), brass section, festive energy, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.funk: Brazilian funk melody (funk melody romântico), funk carioca beat, heavy bass, catchy repetitive hook, clean family-friendly lyrics, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.reggae: Brazilian reggae, offbeat guitar skank, deep bass, one-drop drums, relaxed groove, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.rap: Brazilian hip hop, rhythmic rap verses, melodic sung hook, boom bap beat, warm positive vibe, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.valsa: romantic waltz, 3/4 time, strings and piano, elegant and classic, Brazilian Portuguese
estilos.infantil: Brazilian children's party song, ukulele, xylophone, claps, bright and playful, simple melody, kids choir backing, Brazilian Portuguese

negativo_estilo.sertanejo: American country, bluegrass, banjo, rock, English
negativo_estilo.gospel: sertanejo, sertanejo romântico, country, folk, twang, accordion, viola caipira, acoustic guitar strumming

dupla.texto: male sertanejo duo singing in harmony in thirds

coral.texto: female lead vocals with a full gospel choir

voz_estilo._como_usar: Texto da voz próprio de um estilo (substitui o de 'voz' para aquele estilo).

gospel.coral: powerful female worship vocals with a full gospel choir

negativo: English, Spanish, European Portuguese accent, explicit lyrics
